name: Complete Pending Identity Verification
summary: Accepts valid flow-specific proof and advances the PendingIdentity to resolution-required without granting normal authorization.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == verifying and pending-identity-flow != none and session-capability == identity-ceremony

setup: Establish valid verification evidence for the active flow.

postconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and credential-proof in [primary,multi-factor,recovery] and session-capability == identity-ceremony
